sources.snippet: Gemma-4-E4B-BF16 + MERaLiON Speech LoRA for Singapore English (MLX) This repository contains MLX LoRA adapter weights and a projector for connecting MERaLiON-3 speech embeddings to a Gemma-4-E4B BF16 decoder. It does not include decoder weights or MERaLiON speech encoder weights; users must supply compatible MLX model locations under the applicable upstream terms.
